lesson_text: Do not find merge commits for a path check with `git rev-list <range> -- <paths>`: default history simplification hides a merge whose tree on those paths equals one parent's (a merge that silently drops another parent's change) and lists a clean merge that combines changes from several parents. Enumerate the merges without a pathspec and compare each file with the parent that changed it. A release script that force-pushes a moving tag must lease on the value it read before its checks (`--force-with-lease=refs/tags/<t>:<old>`, empty for "absent"), or a concurrent release is rolled back.
